free_tier.stated: A free LXC container: 256 MB RAM, 3 GB disk, Alpine Linux, managed at ssp.mikr.us. The vendor's own page states the service is for users in Poland. The live origin returned a Polish-only block page on the day read, so the specification is taken from the search index's cached copy of the vendor's own page, not from a live read.
free_tier.notes: the shape is reported, not documented: the live page was refused. See evidence for the exact 403 body

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a container, not an object

retention.stated: Reported from the cached copy: 'Serwery, na które nikt nie logował się przez 3 miesiące, są usuwane.' (servers nobody has logged into for 3 months are deleted).
retention.notes: reported, because the live origin refused the read

egress.terms: not stated on the cached page and not readable live

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: PLN 35 (about EUR 8) a year for 384 MB and 5 GB on the paid ladder makes this the cheapest documented European VPS floor; the free FROG tier is the same operator's loss leader into it.

limits.value: 256 MB RAM and 3 GB disk on the free FROG container
deleted after 3 months with no login
a one-off payment of at least PLN 5 is required as an identity check before the free server is activated

limits_note: The server is deleted after three months without a login, and the service states it is intended for users in Poland, so the free unit survives only with a recurring manual login.
binding_note: the free server is not free of payment: a one-off minimum PLN 5 transfer is the identity gate, and on top of it the service refuses non-Polish users outright

identity_cost.detail: Two gates. First, the offer is limited to Poland: the live origin served a block page reading 'The FROG service is intended for Polish users only. Even if you use a VPN, if we detect that you are not Polish, you will lose your account.' Second, the cached vendor page states a one-off payment of at least PLN 5 is required as identity verification. No card is stored, but the payment is a bank transfer and the account is conditional on being in Poland.

reliability_note: no reliability event observed; the origin refused every read from outside Poland with HTTP 403 on 2026-10-24, which is the geo gate working as documented
